'''Jeremy Dallaire''' (also published as '''Jeremy Dalliere''', '''Jeremy Daillere''' and '''Jeremy Dellaire''') is a Connecticut Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2001 Terryville tournament]] on 8 August 2001 with draft deck starting the Galactic Senate, according to John Mullarkey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2811">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-08-terryville-coruscant-party-8-8-01d2811/ terryville-coruscant-party-8-8-01], DeckTech (John "Scythykins" Mullarkey, 8 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-08-terryville-coruscant-party-8-8-01d2811/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He also played at [[September 1999 Bristol tournament]], the [[2000 Connecticut State Championship]] and [[September 2001 Meriden tournament]].
